# BFI · Marwari Invitations

> Studio in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India that designs premium digital wedding invitations only for Marwari families. Each invitation is a mobile website with the couple's and families' names, every function (Ganesh puja, Mayra, Pithi/Haldi, Mehendi, Mahila Sangeet, Baraat, Phere, Reception) with date, time and Google Maps, music, photo gallery, RSVP and a QR code, shared on WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Packages: Basic from ₹3,999 (ready in 24 hours), Premium from ₹6,999 (48 hours), Luxury from ₹11,999 (72 hours).
- Payment: 50% to start, 50% after the customer approves the invitation. UPI or bank transfer.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marwari + Hindi, bilingual.
- One free round of changes; spelling fixes always free. Links stay live at least 6 months after the wedding.
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 89495 09745, email myselfhkjha@gmail.com, 10am – 8pm, all days.
